services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: We have been renting boats and motors since we started Birch Hill Camp in 1969. My father used to rent the Geisler wooden boats, made from cedar. We have come a long way since then! We have 15ft aluminum boats with 15hp outboards that can accommodate 2 to 3 people, and for 2 people they are a great fishing vessel. We have moved up with our boats and motors: we now have three larger boats with 40, 50, and 60hp motors on the 16 to 18ft aluminum boats. These boats come complete with live wells, depth finders and trolling motors. services.name: Eco Cabins
services.desc: “Eco Cabin” is just a cool name for an economical and ecologically-friendly small cabin. They feature two double beds, a two-burner propane stove, a fully equipped kitchen, and a fridge. To accommodate the absence of bathroom facilities in the eco cabins, we have three flush-toilet locations on Birch Hill Camp property, and one shower house. We wanted to offer an option that was economical, simple, but had everything you needed if you don’t want to sleep in a tent. Consider it “glamping”; you get to enjoy a cool comfortable floor, 4 walls, roof, the basic necessities, and at an affordable price. services.name: Rental Trailer
services.desc: Due to increasing cottage demand, we have an air conditioned trailer that we rent out. It comes with a complete add-a-room built on the front, so you get twice the space. It’s a full 30’ trailer complete with a queen bed and double (pullout couch), and with the add-on there’s an extra double pull-out couch and single bed. Fully finished and furnished, with a four-piece bath. Equipped with satellite television! Some guests prefer our trailer over our cottages. The trailer has a very secluded private location with a huge front lawn that gives you plenty of room to enjoy the fire pit, and lots of to room to play with the kids. blurb: Birch Hill Camp is a 50-year-old, family-run tourist camp. Situated on beautiful Lake Nosbonsing in Corbeil, Northern Ontario, we offer a choice of 5 housekeeping cottages, two eco cabins, and a rental trailer.
